name: parallel-test-two-pass-retry-plan-b
title: Story #7 (OSS-launch fix-wave): two-pass retry in run-all-smokes runner (Plan B)
description: Add a second execution pass to the run-all-smokes runner that retries any smoke that timed out in pass 1 using --jobs 1 serial mode. Since every smoke passes individually in single-process mode (B-24c3 + B-be91 data), retry effectively converts 'timed out under load' to 'passed on retry'. Unlocks test:all as a reliable CI gate for OSS launch. Adds optional noRetry manifest field + --no-retry CLI flag for CI strict mode. Scope: run-all-smokes.ts (narrowly unfrozen for two-pass logic) + smoke-manifest schema + self-smoke fixture + CHANGELOG + docs. 0 production code change, 0 existing smoke source change, 0 manifest timeoutMs change.
